tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Most of every page is this colour.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Plates: cards, illustration grounds, window chrome, the scoper and AWS panels.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Quiet button fill, tags, hover on rows. Never put label text (ink-3) on it.

tokens.name: bg-glass
tokens.usage: The floating nav pill and buttons over photographs, always with a 14px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body emphasis, primary button fill. Reads on bg, bg-2, bg-3 in both themes (16:1 and up).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Running copy and descriptions on bg, bg-2, bg-3 (6.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Mono labels and metadata on bg and bg-2 (4.5:1 or better). Not on bg-3 in light (4.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: The receding second line of a two-tone headline, 24px and up only, on bg and bg-2 (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section rules, the construction frame, dividers. Decoration only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairlines: window chrome dots, wireframe blocks, table rules.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of controls that have no fill: unselected chips, inputs, the scoper's text field (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The signal. Primary action fills, selected chips, the one highlighted path in an illustration, focus rings. White text on it (on-blue) is 5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of blue fills.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Blue words on bg and bg-2: links, the blue half of a headline, blue labels (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an active node in diagrams and of a highlighted text run. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue fills.

tokens.name: art
tokens.usage: Illustration linework: outlines, contours, connectors. Decorative; marks that carry meaning use art-ink or blue.

tokens.name: art-2
tokens.usage: Illustration auxiliary lines: dashed guides, minor contours, registration crosses.

tokens.name: art-ink
tokens.usage: Illustration solids: the chip that stands for Adamass, anchor nodes, the probe.

tokens.name: art-fill
tokens.usage: Illustration faces: the tops of plates, documents, the globe.

tokens.name: art-side
tokens.usage: Illustration side faces and track channels.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Geist at weight 500 with tight negative tracking. Scale down to 42px on phones.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Senior engineering for products that ship.
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headlines. Often two-tone: ink, then ink-4 or blue-text.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles, step titles, project names.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Running text stays near 65 characters per line.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We build our own products and help teams ship theirs.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display or heading. ink-2.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The senior who scopes your project is the one who writes the code.
styles.usage: Everything else. ink-2, with the closing sentence of a block in ink.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Coordinates, never sentences. Always set label in uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Bracketed eyebrows, spec keys, tab captions. Uppercase, ink-3, two to four words.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Region ids, tags, numbers inside UI.

spacing.note: 4px base. Sections breathe: space-10 to space-11 between them on desktop.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and tags, between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter, inner padding of small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap in card grids.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between a headline and its lead.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop gap between columns of a statement block.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, the corner of a chip inside a diagram.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Window tabs, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Browser windows, screenshots.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and illustration plates.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels: scoper, AWS explorer.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the nav pill.

shadow.note: Two shadows only. Everything else is separated by bg-2 plates and hairlines.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Product windows and phones floating over the hero photograph.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Small overlays: the open slot card, menus.

layout.note: One centred shell with hairline edges.

tokens.name: shell-max
tokens.usage: Max content width. The construction frame's hairlines sit on its edges.

tokens.name: nav-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the floating nav pill.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length of running text.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; it shrinks to space-4 on phones.
